mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 63 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail with a Waning Crescent moon phase.
The Public Works Department is reminding residents that they manage our local street and utility maintenance, and you can stay updated on their efforts by subscribing to the city newsletter.
There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today, while tomorrow features the downtown farmers market and live music at Paddy Mac's.
In police news, on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old man who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and since the restaurant is open, you have plenty of time to stop by before they lock up at 10:00 PM.
